entities.name: P20147 Plasmodium HSP90
observations: The 193-aa query is reported as an exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt P20147, annotated as a cytoplasmic HSP90 molecular chaperone.
The query contains Pfam HSP90 domain PF00183 at residues 1–176; annotation associates HSP90 with ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, and ATP-dependent protein folding.
Query is 193 aa, so this sequence alone should be described as an HSP90 fragment/domain rather than asserted to be a full-length HSP90 protein.
